name: Train/Test Split Integrity
summary: Verify there is no data leakage between train and test sets
purpose: Verify there is no data leakage between train and test sets. Confirm actual split ratios are within 5% of declared ratios.
assignment_instructions: You are verifying train/test split integrity. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "dataset_train_test_integrity_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - train_rows (integer) - test_rows (integer) - total_rows (integer) - actual_train_ratio (number): train_rows / total_rows - declared_train_ratio (number or null) - ratio_difference (number or null): abs(actual_train_ratio - declared_train_ratio) - ratio_within_tolerance (boolean): ratio_difference <= 0.05, or true if declared_train_ratio is null - overlap_detected (boolean): whether any rows appear in both train and test - overlap_count (integer or null): number of overlapping rows, 0 if none - overlap_percentage (number or null): overlap_count / total_rows - leakage_flag (boolean): true if overlap_detected or not ratio_within_tolerance Compute actual_train_ratio as train_rows / total_rows. Compute ratio_difference as abs(actual_train_ratio - declared_train_ratio) if declared_train_ratio is provided. Flag leakage_flag as true if overlap_detected == true OR ratio_within_tolerance == false. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

deterministic_checks.description: leakage_flag must be true when overlap detected or ratio out of tolerance

math_checks.description: Actual fraction of data in training set
Absolute difference between actual and declared train ratio
Percentage of total data that overlaps between splits

evidence_checks.description: Must be based on actual row-by-row comparison, not estimate
Must be exact count, not estimate
Must be computed from actual row counts

flag_rules.description: Train and test sets contain overlapping rows (data leakage)
Actual train ratio differs from declared by more than 5%
No leakage detected and split ratio within tolerance
